body:
1. (#457) In apps/docs/lib/integration-facts.mjs, update GEMINI_INTEGRATION surfacesSection.title, phaseRoutesHeader.entryHeader, and installSection.title from Antigravity to Gemini, and add a regression test in apps/docs/test/integration-facts.test.mjs.
2. (#547) In .adlc/specs/codex-build-gate.md, update the stale 256 KiB byte threshold claim to 8 MiB.
3. (#864) In docs/integrations/harness-capability-matrix.md, update the shared invariant to state that primitives are either imported from @adlc/core or carried as generated/drift-pinned copies (naming the drift tests), and rename the agy = Antigravity column/tier labels to gemini = Gemini (Antigravity & JetSki).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Verify: `node --test apps/docs/test/integration-facts.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: Fix Gemini integration-facts strings, codex-build-gate spec byte threshold, and harness-capability-matrix drift (#457, #547, #864)
